Acceptance criteria: Real priorities, ages and direct links
Real stages or truthful empty state
Reuse in queue preview and Home
Header-cell text aligns at all densities
Reset, no results, keyboard and counts
No crushed table or clipped buttons
Clear phases, owner, timing and CTA
Decision, rationale and next action clear
Long IDs, counts, chips and empty state
Last success and error when available
Same totals labels and a11y alternative
No false success or lost edits
No secrets/org IDs in public assets
